responsibility: Defines the LLVM debuginfo subsystem entry points and per-codegen-unit state, owns DIBuilder lifecycle and module finalization, and implements the `DebugInfoBuilderMethods` bridge that turns rustc SSA/MIR debug requests into LLVM variable, location, scope, and vtable metadata emission.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `debuginfo/metadata/enums/mod.rs`, this is the top-level debuginfo integration layer for LLVM codegen. It manages the codegen unit debug context, DIBuilder creation/finalization, module flags, and the `DebugInfoBuilderMethods` implementation, instead of specializing in one kind of type metadata. Unlike `coverageinfo/mod.rs` and `llvm/mod.rs`, its scope is debug metadata emission rather than coverage or general LLVM utilities.
